title: The Rain Cape Too Wide for One
youtube_title: The Rain Cape Too Wide for One | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A smaller piece, fairly given, can still be enough.
summary: At a bakery counter on a soft, busy morning, Uma sees that a rain cape cut a little too wide for one will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Uma makes a smaller, even share so Yael is included, and Ms. Okonkwo lets the choice stand without a speech.
